_note: Normalization constants the frozen atomblob7 v2.1 encoder was pretrained with. Copied into this repo from VoxBind's xray_resample_plinder_v2p1/resample.json, which lives under a gitignored data/ dir and therefore does not exist on a fresh checkout. prepare_mcpp_holo_density.py reads only the 'normalization' block; the box-specific ccp4_dir/train_time_note fields were dropped. These values MUST match the encoder checkpoint -- a density map normalized differently is a different input distribution.

normalization.scheme: pocket-pool arcsinh soft-squash + z-score (v6 stats, PLINDER)
